text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Oh! That was some sweet cornering, nicely 
done!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I actually felt that way too. I'm 
still not great at it, but it's better 
than before."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you really tend to drift wide on 
left-handed courses, after all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Still, you kept it in check pretty well 
back there! Is that like, another 
technical thing? Feels like you've changed 
somehow lately~

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's probably because you're so good at 
teaching, Trainer. It's very easy to 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"That person showed me a demonstration of 
'how to take a good turn.'"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A demonstration... of how Umamusume 
run?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but in slow motion. Naturally, I 
can't imitate the speed.
choice_data_list:
L-Like this! Keep the torso angle 
steady... ngh!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I understand completely. That's 
enough now. That posture looks strenuous, 
so please don't push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, hahaha! What's that, lemme see! Your 
Trainer is hilarious~!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
“—And that is what happened. Your guidance 
truly is magnificent.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An out-of-the-blue report... Though 
slightly embarrassing, it seems our 
training is bearing solid fruit!
choice_data_list: I'm glad I could be of help.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
When I told her, "It was super jiggly and 
fun," Pokke said she wanted to see it too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"No good, huh? Too bad. I really wanted 
you to see it, though. Because my Trainer 
is just that incredible."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was caught a little off guard, but being 
praised so straightforwardly made me very 
happy.
